Each page: 5s settle, fonts.ready, small scroll; computed style of first visible h1/h2, the largest text in the first 3 screens (display), first paragraph >90 chars (body), first nav/header link, first small label (<=13.5px, outside nav/footer). families = faces carrying >3% of visible characters. trackingEm = letter-spacing / font-size. ratio = display px / body px.
